items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: So Captain Dryer was the band director and so I went to see Captain Dryer and I told him I'd like to get in the second band... then I went to go in the second band, starting from the beginning and taking lessons in the second. band.

ctx.x: Did your brother play an instrument?
Yes, he was a trumpet player. Remember, I told you before, Captain Dryer said why in the world did Clarence let you come here without some kind of horn.
